top_signals.title: Trump’s ‘Mother Of All Bombs’ Threat Unlikely to Hit Iran’s Buried Nuclear Sites
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump’s threat to use what’s known as the “Mother Of All Bombs” to hit Iran might be effective at hitting some military targets but would do little to destroy nuclear facilities buried deep under a mountain.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US federal judge denies joint Gemini-CFTC bid to undo $5 million settlement
top_signals.summary: The court noted that Gemini voluntarily settled three weeks before trial and that policy changes do not warrant reopening the judgment.

top_signals.title: Post Office weighs bid for ATM operator in cashpoint expansion
top_signals.summary: The Post Office is weighing a bid for one of the UK’s largest independent ATM operators in a move that would expand its cashpoint empire, City AM can reveal.
